Frequently Asked Questions

Is this safe? Will I get banned?

Our bypass uses JWT token interception and does not modify any game files. It works at the network proxy level, making it undetectable to anti-cheat systems.

How long does activation take?

UPI payments are verified automatically within 30–60 seconds. Your UID is whitelisted instantly after payment confirmation.

My token isn't working — what to do?

Ensure you're entering the exact token code (CST-XXXXXX format). Tokens are one-time use. Contact support on Telegram if the issue persists.
